title: Closure under existential polynomial witnesses
statement: Let $i$ be a nonzero natural number, and let $L,L'$ be languages of finite binary strings with $L'\in\Sigma_i^P$. For any natural numbers $C,c$, if for every binary string $x$, membership $x\in L$ is equivalent to the existence of a binary string $u$ of length $C(|x|+1)^c$ such that $\langle x,u\rangle\in L'$, then $L\in\Sigma_i^P$.
hypotheses_covered: $L,L'$ are languages of finite binary strings
